chunks: Jabir said: Abu Ja'far عليه السلام said:

If no men are present for the deceased, a woman steps forward in their middle, and the women stand on her right and her left, while she is in their midst, pronouncing the takbirs until she finishes the salat.

key_terms.النِّسْوَةُ: the women participating in the funeral prayer
key_terms.الْمَرْأَةُ: the woman who steps forward to lead in this circumstance
key_terms.الْمَيِّتَ: the deceased person for whom the funeral prayer is being performed
key_terms.تُكَبِّرُ: she pronounces the takbirs of the funeral prayer

ai.seo_question: How should women perform salat al-janazah if no men are present?
ai.summary: This hadith states the ruling for the funeral prayer when no men are present for the deceased. A woman leads the women by standing in their middle, with the others on her right and left, and she recites the takbirs until the funeral salat is completed.
